The project is a simple educational combinational logic circuit implemented in Wokwi.

results.summary_before: This design debounces the two signals from a rotary encoder and outputs a clean clock and an up/down direction signal. It is intended to be connected to a rotary encoder, preferably one from an Arduino set, and the outputs can be used with a counter. The design is tested by connecting the encoder to the inputs and checking the outputs. It is a simple utility block for interfacing mechanical encoders with digital logic.
